lead.headline: Treasury yields hit their highest since 2007 as stocks fall
lead.dek: The same bond paid 1.7% in 2021. Thirty-year mortgages are now past 6.6%.
body: The yield on the 30-year Treasury bond reached 5.3% this week, its highest since 2007, PBS NewsHour reported, as heavy government and corporate borrowing drove up the return investors demand for lending to the government.

David Lynch of The Washington Post told the program that companies have borrowed about $500 billion this year for artificial-intelligence infrastructure, competing with governments for scarce capital. The national debt passed $40 trillion this week. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Wednesday he would increase buybacks of long-dated debt; stocks fell again Thursday as that relief faded.

briefs.headline: USS Abraham Lincoln leaves the Middle East after nine months
briefs.summary: The carrier and about 5,000 sailors and Marines are three weeks from San Diego. The USS George Washington has arrived to relieve it.

briefs.headline: Flock license plate cameras vandalized in 36 states
briefs.summary: NPR counted damage reports in at least 36 states, and more than 100 cities have switched cameras off or cancelled contracts.

briefs.headline: Wahab wins the California special election for Swalwell's seat
briefs.summary: The state lawmaker takes the 14th District through January and is the first Afghan American in Congress.

briefs.headline: Congo to get 70,000 Ebola doses as deaths pass 2,400
briefs.summary: The Bundibugyo outbreak has killed 2,476 of 5,208 confirmed cases. Twenty thousand doses go to a trial against that strain.

briefs.headline: Seven countries call Israel's E1 settlement plan unacceptable
briefs.summary: Israel opened tenders for more than 1,200 homes in a project of at least 3,400. Britain, France, Germany, Canada and three others objected.

briefs.headline: German intelligence finds an arms cache in a Brandenburg forest
briefs.summary: The domestic intelligence service said the depot was a Russian dead-letter drop and that two firearms in it were meant for agents.

briefs.headline: PSC staff moves to pause or dismiss a 500-kilovolt line case
briefs.summary: Staff said five route changes NextEra filed July 30 give three newly affected landowners 39 days on a 107.5-mile line.

briefs.headline: Bluefield State board meets in emergency session, says nothing
briefs.summary: The notice gave the purpose as imminent substantial harm to the institution. The administration said it was told nothing more.

regional.item: Curbside flood debris pickup starts Monday on Campbells Creek, Cabin Creek and Cross Lanes, through Sept. 4.
A mobile FEMA center is open daily in Ritchie County through Saturday for residents hit by July's flooding.

away.item: A Beech King Air 200 landed on Foothills Boulevard Thursday, hit cars and killed one person on the ground.

fishing.line: 350 cfs and falling - pushy. Wadeable at the edges, not across.
Sound highs 3:15 a.m. and 3:56 p.m. at Hampstead; the afternoon tide is bigger at 3.9 feet.

briefs.headline: Home stool test cut colorectal cancer deaths 43% in Sweden
briefs.summary: Karolinska Institutet followed 376,511 people for up to 14 years. Those merely invited to screen cut their risk 26%.

briefs.headline: A lost cliff may explain the Grand Canyon's missing billion years
briefs.summary: Southampton geologists date a kilometre-high escarpment to the breakup of Rodinia 800 million years ago.

briefs.headline: Physicists describe a droplet that holds itself together
briefs.summary: Monash University calculates that bosons and fermions can balance attraction against pressure to form a stable drop.
